project: Real-Data E2E Loop C: Trust, Citation, and Export Contract
overview: Stabilize citation evidence outcomes and strict fail-closed export behavior while landing the Phase 0 demo-prod allowlist quick win for pack_09_bad_citation.
goals: Keep trust behavior fail-closed and user-visible.
Eliminate hidden fallback masking in citation response paths.
Improve demo-prod operator reliability with minimal-scope allowlist expansion.
nonGoals: Broad allowlist expansion for all packs in this phase.
Relaxing fail-closed trust policies or enabling unsafe exports by default.
Full prod-mode rollout of trust/export workflows.
successMetrics: Citation open path shows explicit success or typed failure with no silent ambiguity.
Exports remain fail-closed with stable EXPORT_BLOCKED behavior for unsafe scenarios.
openQuestions: Should pack_09 operator smoke coverage run on every PR or nightly-only after initial rollout?
Do we need a dedicated operator-facing copy spec for blocked export recovery CTAs?

stack.hosting: Local dev and demo-prod operator surfaces
stack.auth: Existing mode and route gating (dev/demo-prod), no auth model changes in this slice

routes.name: Citation API
routes.purpose: Return verifiable citation payload or typed failure

routes.name: Document render API
routes.purpose: Provide render URL behavior for citation evidence

routes.name: Document PDF API
routes.purpose: Serve PDF retrieval behavior for citation verification

routes.name: Export API
routes.purpose: Enforce fail-closed export gating via EXPORT_BLOCKED

routes.name: Demo load-pack API
routes.purpose: Allowlist and load demo packs including pack_09_bad_citation

uiNotes: Invalid citations must show citation_failed UI and no stale highlight overlays.
Blocked exports must include actionable recovery path into report triage.
Demo toolbar pack list must include pack_09_bad_citation and preserve existing pack options.

importFormat.description: Operator smoke flow uses allowlisted demo pack IDs; export/citation behavior is validated against run and citation outcomes.

rules: Citation outcomes must be explicit success payloads or typed failure envelopes.
Fail-closed export behavior is mandatory when trust preconditions fail.
Allowlist expansion is additive and limited to explicit approved pack IDs.
Each story must include one positive and one negative verification path.

stories.title: Citation evidence requests return explicit stable outcomes
stories.description: As a reviewer, I want citation lookups to return either verifiable evidence or typed failure so trust decisions are auditable.
acceptanceCriteria: Citation open path returns deterministic success payload or typed failure envelope.
Render and PDF retrieval behavior is explicit for missing or invalid citation anchors.
Example: valid citation opens expected document page with trust metadata and render URL.
Negative: invalid citation never renders stale highlight overlays or ambiguous success UI.

stories.title: Export fail-closed contract remains strict and observable
stories.description: As an operator, I want blocked exports to be deterministic so unsafe outputs cannot be downloaded.
acceptanceCriteria: Export route enforces EXPORT_BLOCKED whenever run, report, or citation safety preconditions are not met.
Blocked export states surface actionable UX to inspect failed rows and evidence.
Example: pack_09_bad_citation run results in blocked export with explicit reason and no downloadable artefact.
Negative: blocked or incomplete runs must never produce signed download links.

stories.title: Demo-prod operator allowlist includes pack_09_bad_citation
stories.description: As a demo operator, I want to select pack_09_bad_citation from the toolbar so trust/fail-closed scenarios can be demonstrated without manual API calls.
acceptanceCriteria: Load-pack API schema allowlist includes pack_09_bad_citation.
Demo toolbar pack dropdown includes pack_09_bad_citation and loads it successfully.
Example: operator selects pack 09, starts a run, and observes blocked export behavior end to end.
Negative: non-allowlisted arbitrary pack IDs remain rejected with validation errors.

inScope: Citation evidence path reliability (citation to render to PDF) with explicit typed outcomes.
Export fail-closed correctness against report and citation state.
Phase 0 quick wins for pack_09_bad_citation in API allowlist and demo toolbar.
Operator smoke checks for load to run to export-blocked contract.
functionalRequirements: FR-001: Standardize citation outcome envelope across citation/render/pdf routes.
FR-002: Preserve strict fail-closed export gating for unsafe or unresolved evidence states.
FR-003: Add pack_09_bad_citation allowlist in load-pack API and toolbar options.
FR-004: Ensure operator smoke coverage exists for pack_09 fail-closed flow.
FR-005: Keep compatibility for existing allowlisted packs pack_01_clean and pack_02_missing_rea.
failureStatesAndUX: Invalid citation: explicit citation_failed presentation and no highlight overlays.
Blocked export: clear blocked reason and triage or review recovery action.
Allowlist validation failure: typed input error with no side effects.
metricsLogging: export_blocked_total by run id and failure category.
rollbackDisablePath: Allowlist quick win can be reverted by removing pack_09_bad_citation from API and UI enums.
Citation envelope normalization can fall back while keeping fail-closed export defaults intact.

risks: Citation fallback branches may still mask typed failures in edge cases.
Toolbar and API allowlist drift could reintroduce operator confusion.
dependencies: Depends on Loop B run/report contract for reliable export gating decisions.
Depends on existing citation/render/pdf route contracts remaining stable.

verificationPlan: Run citation checks for pack_01_clean and pack_09_bad_citation and verify explicit outcome states.
Execute export attempt on pack_09 run and assert EXPORT_BLOCKED with no artefact download.
Perform demo-prod operator smoke for toolbar load pack, run start, and blocked export.
